test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

We _________ off old clothes and bought new ones for Diwali.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cast**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Cast**" means to throw or discard something, which fits the context of the sentence. (किसी चीज़ को फेंकना या त्यागना)
 
• In this context, "**cast off**" can mean to get rid of or discard something. 
 
• **Complete sentence**: *We cast __off old clothes and bought new ones for Diwali.*

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Cost**" refers to the price of something and does not make sense in this context. (किसी चीज़ की कीमत)
 
• "**Coast**" refers to the shoreline of a body of water and does not make sense in this context. (किसी जलराशि की तटरेखा)
 
• "**Caste**" refers to a social class system and does not make sense in this context. (एक सामाजिक वर्ग प्रणाली)
